fly.name: Fly
fly.desc: Control your Ki to Fly! Jump and press the Fly Key mid-air to Fly, level up the skill to increase your speed.

jump.name: Jump
jump.desc: Let's you Jump higher. The more you level up, the higher you can jump.

sprint.name: Sprint
sprint.desc: Sprints you faster. The more you level up, the faster you can sprint.

ki_protection.name: Ki Protection
ki_protection.desc: Blocks the incoming damage at the cost of your Ki. Level up the skill to increase the damage you'll protect.

ki_infusion.name: Ki Infusion
ki_infusion.desc: Infuses your Fists and Weapons with Ki. Level up the skill to increase the damage you'll infuse.

ki_sense.name: Ki Sense
ki_sense.desc: Allows you to sense the ki of nearby entities, making it easier to locate them.

ki_control.name: Ki Control
ki_control.desc: Learn to Control your Ki. It's a basic skill to use Ki Attacks, Fly or other Ki-based actions.

ki_manipulation.name: Ki Manipulation
ki_manipulation.desc: Master the Ki Manipulation to be able to create Ki Weapons, increasing your Melee Damage based on your Ki Damage!

potential_unlock.name: Potential Unlock
potential_unlock.desc: Let's you Unlock your real Potential to increase your power release to the limit!

defense_penetration.name: Defense Penetration
defense_penetration.desc: Increases your Defense Penetration, allowing you to ignore a percentage of your enemy's defense when attacking.

healing_reduction.name: Healing Reduction
healing_reduction.desc: Your attacks reduce the target's healing (health regeneration and food healing) by 2% per level for a short time.

instant_transmission.name: Instant Transmission
instant_transmission.desc: Instantly teleport to a location within your line of sight by controlling your Ki. Leveling up this skill increases the maximum teleportation distance. (Lv 5+) Hold the Key to open an interface to teleport to Masters.

ki_boost.name: Ki Boost
ki_boost.desc: Increases your Active Ki regeneration rate by 25% per level. Does not affect your passive Ki regeneration rate.

kaioken.name: Kaioken
kaioken.desc: A powerful technique that multiplies your stats but strains your body.

ultimate.name: Ultimate
ultimate.desc: Unlease your power to the limit! Ultimate Forms takes the multiplier of your strongest-compatible form and applies it to your stats with a bonus!

ultra_instinct.name: Ultra Instinct
ultra_instinct.desc: An ultimate, divine technique that severs the connection between the mind and body, allowing the user to react, dodge, and attack automatically without conscious thought.

ultra_ego.name: Ultra Ego
ultra_ego.desc: It is a state of mind focused on selfishness, allowing the user to unleash limitless power the more they revel in destruction.

meditation.name: Meditation
meditation.desc: Boosts your Passive Ki Regeneration and Stamina Recovery.

superforms.name: Super Forms
superforms.desc: Access to powerful transformations unique to your race.

godforms.name: God Forms
godforms.desc: Access to divine transformations with godly ki.

legendaryforms.name: Legendary Forms
legendaryforms.desc: Access to rare and legendary transformations.

fusion.name: Fusion
fusion.desc: Learn the Fusion technique to combine powers with another warrior.

androidforms.name: Android Forms
androidforms.desc: Access to powerful android transformations (exclusive for upgraded humans).

racial_human.name: Blood-Fueled Ki
racial_human.desc: Ki attacks cost 25% less Ki — the saved amount is drawn from your health instead (12.5% of the original cost as HP). That HP drain is then added as flat bonus damage on the attack's first hit. Android Upgraded: The discount rises to 50%, all Ki regen is doubled, but Ki attacks deal 15% less damage.

racial_saiyan.name: Zenkai
racial_saiyan.desc: Upon staying 8 seconds below 15%% health, Saiyans will receive a Zenkai boost, which heals them by %d%% of their max health and increases their stats by a %d%%. This has a %d seconds cooldown. A Saiyan can receive a maximum of %d Zenkai boosts. Only works from level %d onwards.

racial_namekian.name: Assimilation
racial_namekian.desc: Namekians can assimilate with other Namekians by selecting the Skill on the X menu, then holding G next to a Namekian. When assimilating, you will regen %d%% of your max health, and will also gain a permanent %d%% (of your stats) boost to your stats. You can assimilate a maximum of %d times.

racial_frostdemon.name: Prodigious Strength
racial_frostdemon.desc: Frost Demons have prodigius strength, increasing their TP Gain ratio by %d%%. Stacking with other boosts like HTC.

racial_bioandroid.name: Life Drain
racial_bioandroid.desc: Bio-Androids can drain the life force of their enemies by selecting the skill on the X menu and pressing G, dealing %d%% of their max health as damage and healing themselves for the same amount. This has a %d seconds cooldown.

racial_majin.name: Absorption
racial_majin.desc: Majins can absorb other entities by selecting the skill on the X menu and pressing G. When absorbing, you will regen %d%% of your max health, and will also gain a permanent %d%% (of the target stats) boost to your stats. You can absorb a maximum of %d times.
